g.text: Class Diagram (Design) - BCK10 Predefined Pizza Management
-validate(pizza: Product, componentIds: string[], facts: ConfigurationFacts): void
Routes validate the productId path parameter
with the local validateParams helper before
Authentication and MANAGER authorization run first.
Repository contract belongs to the Product aggregate's
domain layer. BCK10 consumes the BCK05 contract; the
PostgreSQL adapter remains owned by BCK05.
listPredefinedPizzas() is the BCK10 list query contract.
PredefinedPizza is a Product subtype and uses ProductId;
BCK10 adds composition to the BCK05 Product aggregate.
